summary:
I rebuilt the app from HEAD f513faf as the shipped single-file exe (139,896,472 bytes). It ran on this machine's real desktop against synthetic NTFS trees and against two real folders, C:\Program Files (3 unreadable folders) and C:\ProgramData (573 unreadable folders). It ran at the default size, at the 560x644 floor, and maximized (1936x1048).

All eleven material criteria (1–11) hold, and I re-ran their cases myself: B-007, S-001..S-009, C-001 and B-008 all exit 0 with no FAIL line.

I read the report JSON directly for both obligations aimed at this stage, not through the cases' own checks.
- **O-001:** at the floor with the unreadable tab selected, LargestFilesList reads inView=false and fullRows=0 while keeping its 98.96 px, and UnreadableList reads inView=true. OutcomeTabs is 164.84 px in both states, on a synthetic tree and on C:\Program Files. It is 164 px in both on C:\ProgramData.
- **O-002:** the tab headers stay on one row (stripRows=1) with 'Unreadable folders (12,345)'. That holds in S-007 (real 12,345 denied folders) and in a scratch build I made with all four planned headers.
- **The row count is a real measure.** Headers long enough to wrap made the report read stripRows=2, and both lists lost about 20 px.
- **Adding sections works.** The scratch build added two tabs with no new RowDefinition or MinHeight, and the fit held at 560x644: the tabs stayed 164.84 px and the largest-files list kept 2 full rows.

The verdict is partial, not passes, because O-016 is still unfixed at this HEAD. The ScrollViewer rule at .taad/fitness.yaml:810 is the old narrow pattern. Tested with Python's re:
- It stays quiet when a comment sits between the ScrollViewer and the list.
- It stays quiet when a `<ScrollViewer.Style>` block comes first, and when an attribute value contains '>'.
- It fires wrongly on a self-closing ScrollViewer followed by a sibling list.

So criterion 12's enforcement ("the contract comment and the ScrollViewer rule") is not in place, and I am sending O-016 back to build-slice. Criteria 13 (keyboard tab switching) and 14 (125%/150% scaling) were not checked. Both were marked material:false in the design.

One observation, not a failure: maximized on a Completed scan, the tabs stay at their 164 px minimum and the unreadable list shows 5–6 of 573 rows. That comes from SL-044's 1:3 split between the outcome and the folder tree, not from this slice. The panel itself is filled with nothing left over.

Build, Core tests (381/381), rules-parity (AGREE) and the Fitness check (every rule holds) all pass. The scratch copies, the probe tree and its deny rule, and my temp output files are all removed.

criteria.criterion: 1. show the outcome panel after a scan — no unreadable folders (N=0)
criteria.how: C-001 re-run: exit 0. UnreadableTab not shown, LargestFilesTab selected, stripRows checked, UnreadableExpander alias emitted.

criteria.criterion: 2. show the outcome panel after a scan — at least 1 unreadable folder, default state at the 560x644 floor
criteria.how: S-001 and B-007 re-run and passed. Raw report JSON at 560x644 from the shipped exe: synthetic tree and C:\Program Files show LargestFilesTab selected, 'Unreadable folders (N)' visible and not selected, UnreadableList inView=false, stripRows 1. Fit: texts <=76 + 10 + tabs 164.84 of a 276 px panel.

criteria.criterion: 3. switch to the unreadable section — select UnreadableTab, then back to Largest files
criteria.how: S-002 and B-007 passed. Raw JSON on synthetic, Program Files and ProgramData: tabs 164.84/164.84 (164/164 on ProgramData) across selections. The unselected LargestFilesList reads inView=false and fullRows=0 with a stale 98.96 px.

criteria.criterion: 4. start a new scan — UnreadableTab selected when the scan starts, new result has N=0
criteria.how: S-003 re-run: selection moved to LargestFilesTab, UnreadableTab hidden, new rows shown.

criteria.criterion: 5. choose the selected tab — Largest files hidden while Unreadable visible
criteria.how: S-004 re-run with the hook's hide mode, since the state cannot happen in the app. The guard selected UnreadableTab and kept the tabs visible.

criteria.criterion: 6. show outcome text with no lists — no tab visible and a long notes block
criteria.how: S-005 re-run: texts take 378.22 of 404.22 px and scroll 575.24 px inside; not capped at 76.

criteria.criterion: 7. show outcome text above the tabs — long text wrapping at width 560 while tabs visible
criteria.how: S-006 and B-008 re-run: texts scroll inside the 76 px cap and the tabs keep >=164 px. Real C:\ProgramData: texts 76 of 97.12 px, scrolling, with tabs at 164 at the floor.

criteria.criterion: 8. lay out the tab strip — 'Unreadable folders (12,345)' at MinWidth 560
criteria.how: S-007 re-run with real 12,345 denied folders: stripRows 1 in both selections. Scratch build with all four planned headers plus '(12,345)': stripRows 1. Wrap control reads 2.

criteria.criterion: 9. list rows inside a tab — far more rows than the area holds, at 560x644 and maximized
criteria.how: S-008 re-run: 171 ok. Real: LargestFilesList built 3–5 of 100 rows. UnreadableList holds 573 real rows in 136 px with 5–6 full rows, at the floor and maximized.

S-008 re-run (Cancelled: tabs grow, no band). Real maximized Completed runs: panel 276 = 26 + 76 + 10 + 164, no band. The tabs stay at their minimum there because SL-044's 1:3 split holds the outcome row at its 292 MinHeight; that is not this slice's row.

criteria.criterion: 11. load results into a list — rescan replaces ItemsSource while its tab is unselected
criteria.how: S-009 re-run: no throw; after selection the tab shows the second scan's count and its 1 row.

criteria.criterion: 12. add a third section later — a third TabItem added by the next slice (material:false)
criteria.how: Layout half is met. In my scratch build, two added TabItems needed no RowDefinition or MinHeight: tabs stayed 164.84, stripRows 1, list kept 2 full rows. Enforcement half is not met. The design says this is 'enforced by the contract comment and the ScrollViewer rule', and that rule (fitness.yaml:810) misses a comment between ScrollViewer and list and a <ScrollViewer.Style> block first, and false-fires on a self-closing ScrollViewer. O-016 is still open.

criteria.criterion: 13. switch tabs by keyboard — Ctrl+Tab / arrow keys (material:false)
criteria.how: No key input was driven; see checks.
Scaling is a system setting outside this run's reach; the machine is at 100%.

criteria.criterion: build-check open item: outcome panel restructured to scroll or tab instead of per-section star rows and MinHeights
criteria.how: MainWindow.xaml:239-378 is two rows plus the OutcomeTabs TabControl. The Expander and the per-list MinHeights are gone; the only MinHeight is OutcomeTabs' 154. Runtime behaviour as in criteria 2–3.

criteria.criterion: build-check open item: panel ready for largest-folders / by-extension sections without breaking the fit
criteria.how: The scratch four-header build held the 560x644 fit with tabs added only (see criterion 12). The enforcing rule's gap is carried under criterion 12 and O-016.

obligations.evidence: Raw report JSON from the shipped exe at 560x644 with the unreadable tab selected (hook expand mode). Synthetic tree: LargestFilesList inView=false, fullRows=0, actualHeight 98.96; UnreadableList inView=true, 136.88 px. OutcomeTabs 164.84 in both selections. C:\Program Files: the same, 164.84 px. C:\ProgramData: 164/164. B-007 re-run passed with 'kept its height' in the four compared runs.

S-007 re-run (12,345 real denied folders at MinWidth 560): stripRows 1 in both selections. Scratch build with 'Largest files','Largest folders','By extension','Unreadable folders (12,345)': stripRows 1. Negative control with long headers reads stripRows 2 and costs the lists ~20 px, so the measure detects a wrap.

Owed to build-slice and not done at HEAD f513faf. .taad/fitness.yaml:810 still reads (?s)<ScrollViewer\b[^>]*>\s*<(ListView|TreeView|ListBox|DataGrid)\b. Python re on five snippets: bare FIRES; comment-between quiet; <ScrollViewer.Style>-first quiet; '>' in attribute quiet; self-closing + sibling list FIRES (false positive). eng/rules-harness/plants.json has no comment-between or property-element plant row. The slice's own criterion 12 relies on this rule, so build-slice should take its pass back and apply the recorded replacement pattern and the two plant rows.

not_reached: 125% and 150% display scaling (criterion 14): the machine runs at 100% and changing scaling is off-limits here.
Keyboard tab switching (criterion 13): no key input was sent to the window.

The real Largest folders and By extension sections with their own lists and captions. The four-header probe used empty ListBoxes and a hard-coded '(12,345)' header string, and those slices own the real fixture.
A whole-drive scan (C:\) ending, where the build and review say the 76 px text cap makes a ~107 px ending scroll even when maximized. Not run here; only C:\Program Files and C:\ProgramData were.
eng/rules-harness/harness.py S09/S10 through the harness itself. Not run; the known CANNOT MEASURE at this HEAD belongs to build-slice.
The person-run network pass (N-001..N-004, StalledShareTests), made stale by this slice's changes to MainWindow and the hook. Opt-in and not run.

Maximized on a Completed scan, the tabs stay at 164 px (5–6 of 573 unreadable rows visible) because of SL-044's 1:3 outcome/tree split. Whether the person wants more room for the sections there is untested taste, not a measurement.
